summary: Project tracks monthly progression values for habits; update logic so Plank increases by +15 seconds per month starting from 1:00 in January (Feb 1:15), Squash remains fixed at 45:00 every month, and all other habits remain unchanged.

existing_features.title: Ensure the frontend volume display continues to show seconds-accurate values for Plank across months (e.g., 1:15, 1:30, …) based on values returned from the backend, and that Squash displays the same time (e.g., 45:00) for each month. Do not change the behavior of other habits.

new_feature_requests.summary: Amend monthly progression: Plank +15 seconds each month starting Jan 1:00 (Feb 1:15); Squash fixed at 45:00 monthly; leave all other habits unchanged

Update backend monthly compounding so the habit named "Plank" (unitType = "time") increases by exactly +15 seconds per month (e.g., if January is 1:00 then February is 1:15), while the habit named "Squash" (unitType = "time") remains constant across all future months (e.g., 45:00 every month). All other habits must keep the existing compounding behavior unchanged.

Fix backend unitType initialization during volume updates so that time-based edits do not accidentally compound using the default "reps" rules. If a habit has no existing volumeTracking and the incoming volume entry includes a timeString (time input), initialize volumeTracking.unitType to "time" (otherwise keep existing behavior).

projectName: Fix monthly progression rules: Plank +15 seconds/month; Squash constant; others unchanged
